enriched_description: Stuffed toy bear with a soft plush exterior filled with polyester fiberfill. Body is approximately 20-60 cm tall in a seated position. Head is round with two small rounded ears on top. Eyes are black plastic buttons or embroidered thread. Nose is a stitched triangle or oval in black or brown thread. Arms and legs are stubby and jointed at the shoulders and hips. Fur texture is short-pile plush in brown, tan, white, or pastel colors. Some versions wear a ribbon bow around the neck. Overall silhouette is rotund and cuddly.

Rectangular display device with a large flat screen housed in a thin bezel frame. Screen size ranges from 32 to 75+ inches diagonally. Modern flat-panel TVs are 5-10 cm thick with a black glass screen surface. Stand is a flat base or two feet at the bottom. Rear panel has input ports (HDMI, USB, antenna). Older CRT models are box-shaped with a curved glass screen, 40-60 cm deep. Screen displays moving images with vibrant colors. Power indicator LED glows on the front bezel. Remote control sensor window is a small dark rectangle on the front.

Spherical ball approximately 6.7 cm in diameter covered in fluorescent yellow-green felt. Surface has a characteristic fuzzy texture from the felt covering. Two white rubber seams form a continuous curvilinear S-shaped line around the ball. Interior is a hollow rubber core pressurized to approximately 12-14 psi. Weight is 56-59 grams. The felt covering shows wear marks and scuffing from court play. Color is standardized as optic yellow for visibility. Compression is firm but yields slightly under finger pressure.

Roof covering made from layers of dried vegetation (straw, reeds, palm fronds, or heather) bundled and layered thickly. Surface has a textured fibrous appearance with individual stems visible. Thickness is 20-40 cm for proper insulation. Roof pitch is steep (45-55 degrees) to shed water. Color is golden-brown when new, weathering to gray-brown over time. Ridge line is capped with additional thatch or a decorative ridge roll. Eaves extend beyond the wall line. Surface shows a layered overlapping pattern from the thatching technique.

Large heavy fabric drape spanning the width of a theater stage (10-20 meters wide, 8-12 meters tall). Fabric is rich velvet or velour in deep red, burgundy, or gold. Curtain is gathered in deep vertical folds (pleats) creating a scalloped appearance when closed. Top edge is attached to a track or rigging system for raising and lowering. Valance (swag) may drape across the top. When open, the curtain stacks to one or both sides of the stage. Fabric has a lustrous sheen under stage lighting. Bottom edge may have a weighted hem for smooth hanging.

Small cup-shaped protective cap for the fingertip, approximately 1.5-2 cm in diameter and height. Made from metal (silver, brass, steel) or plastic. Surface is covered with a pattern of small dimples or pits to grip the needle. Open at one end, closed at the top with a smooth or decorated dome. Some thimbles have a leather or rubber ring at the base for secure fit. Decorative versions feature engraved patterns, enamel work, or gemstone inlays. Interior is smooth and slightly concave to fit the fingertip.

Large agricultural machine with a rectangular body mounted on wheels or tracks. Front features a wide header (3-10 meters) with rotating reels and cutting blades for harvesting crops. Body houses the threshing drum and separating mechanisms. Grain tank sits on top with an unloading auger extending from the side. Cab is elevated at the front with large windows for visibility. Color is typically red, green, or yellow (brand-specific). Rear has a chaff spreader. Overall length 8-12 meters. Exhaust stack rises from the engine compartment.

Ornate ceremonial chair with a tall decorative backrest and armrests. Seat is elevated on a platform or has tall legs. Backrest may feature carved motifs, upholstery, or a canopy. Materials include carved wood (oak, mahogany), gilded metal, or stone. Seat cushion is upholstered in rich fabric (velvet, brocade) in red, purple, or gold. Armrests are wide and may terminate in carved animal heads or finials. Overall height 1.5-3 meters. Decorative elements include inlay, gilding, and carved reliefs. Positioned on a dais or raised platform.

Roof surface covered with overlapping rows of fired clay tiles. Individual tiles are curved (barrel/S-shaped) or flat with interlocking edges. Color is terracotta red, brown, or orange-brown from the firing process. Tile dimensions approximately 20-40 cm long, 15-25 cm wide. Rows overlap in a staggered pattern creating a rhythmic scalloped texture. Ridge tiles cap the peak line. Surface shows slight color variation between individual tiles. Weathered tiles develop a patina with moss or lichen growth in the valleys.

Compact kitchen appliance with a rectangular body approximately 25-30 cm wide, 18 cm deep, 20 cm tall. Top features two or four vertical slots for inserting bread slices. Front has a lever for lowering bread into the heating chamber. Control dial adjusts browning level. Interior contains nichrome wire heating elements that glow red when operating. Body is chrome-plated metal, stainless steel, or colored plastic. Crumb tray slides out from the bottom. Cord wraps underneath for storage. Surface shows fingerprints on chrome models.
